Plugin.Name: Fluxer for Unraid
Plugin.Overview: Unofficial beta installer for a new Fluxer instance on Unraid 7. The Settings page configures the official Docker Compose stack. Install Compose Manager Plus and the Tailscale plugin first. Web access uses Cloudflare Tunnel and Traefik. Each caller needs VPN access for voice and video. No WAN port forwards are required. Cloudflare DNS and tunnel tokens are required during setup. Removing this plugin keeps existing containers and data.
